messages.subject: Project Lyra — Licence v3 (our counter-mark-up)
messages.plaintextBody:
Oliver,

Our counter is attached (tracked, v3). To land this: royalty at 6.0% (up from your 5.75%), liability cap at 125% (up from your 100%), and — as a cash-flow concession — we've split the £2m milestone into two equal £1m tranches, the second on the first anniversary of first commercial sale. The 36-month longstop stays as you proposed. We think that's a fair place to close. Let us know and we'll turn the execution version.

James Osei
Senior Associate

Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
